purpose: Development benchmark for pitch and melody: the course coach's natural teaching from the pitch lesson; his deliberate mistakes in other foundations, which keep their pitch movement except the quiet demonstration, where his voice drops to a low register; and the user's three readings of one paragraph (high, flat, good). The pitch lesson has no demonstration of a flat or stuck voice by the coach: it shows melody through music, the siren exercise and a student exercise. Provisional transcript/acoustic annotations; not independently listener-validated.
segmentation: Cuts fall in silences between words. Takes keep their internal pauses and the audio is not normalized. Cut points were chosen from Deepgram nova-3 word times; review them by listening.
